reading: The sketch lays out a spreadsheet web-app page: a top title bar (logo, "Q3 Budget", menu, Share pill), a toolbar strip with formatting icons, a formula bar showing the active cell and formula, a large data grid with lettered columns and 12 rows, and a bottom sheet-tab bar (New, Budget, Hiring, Notes tabs plus a running sum) pinned to the bottom of the page. All content/colour details come from the user's typed notes, which take precedence over the raw ink.
